map.高血压(JNC-7)分级与风险分层器 使用指南: Hypertension (JNC-7) Grading and Risk Stratification User Guide
map.基于JNC-7高血压分级标准，结合心血管危险因素、靶器官损害及伴随临床情况，进行: Based on the JNC-7 hypertension classification, combined with cardiovascular risk factors, target organ damage and associated clinical conditions, perform comprehensive risk stratification
map.JNC-7 血压分级：正常 <120/<80；高血压前期 120–139/80–: JNC-7 blood pressure classification: normal below 120/80; prehypertension 120-139/80-89; stage 1 hypertension 140-159/90-99; stage 2 at least 160/100.
map.危险分层：叠加年龄、吸烟、血脂、糖尿病、靶器官损害与合并临床疾病，分低/中/高/: Risk stratification: combine age, smoking, blood lipids, diabetes, target organ damage and associated clinical conditions into low, moderate, high and very high risk, which determines treatment intensity.
map.目标值个体化：一般 <140/90；糖尿病/肾病/心衰多 <130/80（依指南: Individualized targets: generally below 140/90; for diabetes, kidney disease or heart failure often below 130/80 (according to guidelines and tolerance), relaxed appropriately for the elderly.
map.：输入：收缩压 152 mmHg、舒张压 94 mmHg、女、62 岁、糖尿病、: : Input: systolic 152 mmHg, diastolic 94 mmHg, female, 62 years old, diabetes, non-smoker. Tool output: grade - stage 2 hypertension; risk stratification - very high (with diabetes); recommendation - medication plus lifestyle; target - below 130/80 and stable; monitoring - home self-measurement plus complication screening. Note: diagnosis is based on standardized measurement.
map.心肌桥(壁冠状动脉)程度评估器: Myocardial bridging (intramural coronary artery) severity assessor
map.心衰NYHA分级与六分钟步行评估器: Heart failure NYHA class and six-minute walk assessor
map.多不需立即用药，优先生活方式干预（减盐、减重、运动、限酒、减压）并随访；若合并糖: Most do not need medication right away; lifestyle intervention comes first (less salt, weight loss, exercise, limiting alcohol, stress reduction) plus follow-up. If diabetes or high cardiovascular risk is present, a doctor may start medication earlier to prevent target organ damage.
map.诊室一次测量易受体位、情绪与白大衣效应影响；家庭或 24h 动态可反映日常真实血: A single office reading is easily affected by posture, mood and the white-coat effect; home or 24-hour ambulatory monitoring reflects real daily blood pressure, identifies masked hypertension, and helps judge target achievement and adjust the plan.
map.长期不控制会怎样？: What happens if it is not controlled over the long term?
map.持续高压损害心、脑、肾、眼底与血管，增加卒中、心梗、心衰、肾衰与痴呆风险；早诊早: Sustained high blood pressure damages the heart, brain, kidneys, eye fundus and blood vessels, raising the risk of stroke, myocardial infarction, heart failure, kidney failure and dementia; early diagnosis and control with long-term target achievement is the core of reducing complications.
